E4Plus1.uk.description: Zayna Flaming Grill (Part 1/2): Gordon makes the first of two visits to Zayna Flaming Grill, a Mediterranean restaurant in Redondo Beach owned by Faye and her niece Brenda. (S7 Ep6)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Married at First Sight USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: It's been 18 months since a shocking Decision Day left everyone speechless. The brides and grooms reunite and reflect on their MAFS experience. (S19 Ep14)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Knock 'em Down: Jay agrees to join Cam's bowling team for the finals, but doesn't realise that he's not eligible to play in the league. (S6 Ep20)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Integrity: Phil and Jay run an errand together to pick up Lily's hand-me-down princess castle for Joe. Phil is upset that Claire won't let him buy a videogame console. (S6 Ep21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: No Loan Again, Naturally: When Homer and Marge's mortgage rate skyrockets, they have to put their house up for sale - and Flanders buys it and becomes their landlord. (S20 Ep12/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Gone Maggie Gone: When Marge temporarily loses her sight, Homer loses Maggie to a convent and Lisa has to go undercover as a nun to find her. (S20 Ep13/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: In the Name of the Grandfather: Homer takes the family to Ireland so that Grampa can visit quaint village pub O'Flanagan's one last time. (S20 Ep14/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Wedding for Disaster: Homer and Marge discover that they're not officially married when Reverend Lovejoy finds out he wasn't a licensed minister at the time of their ceremony. (S20 Ep15/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: Lockdown: Peralta is left in charge of the precinct at Thanksgiving when Holt and Jeffords are away, but chaos ensues when a strange package is delivered. (S2 Ep7)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
E4Plus1.uk.description: USPIS: Peralta and Boyle reluctantly join forces with Agent Jack Danger (Ed Helms), a pompous investigator at the US Postal Inspection Service, to catch a drug dealer. (S2 Ep8)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Cover-Up: Phil has a new client who is also 'his type'. Afraid that might get him into trouble with Claire, he tells some seemingly innocent lies, which lead to more lies... (S7 Ep16)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Express Yourself: Phil has the crazy idea of going on a spontaneous trip to Paris with Claire. And Jay takes over their bathroom renovation. (S7 Ep17)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Man Shouldn't Lie: Claire brings home a stray dog and gets the kids to help her hide it. And Cameron rents out the upstairs apartment to a Christian rock band. (S7 Ep19)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Promposal: With Closet-Con imminent, Claire's on high alert and convinced there's a company mole. Phil goes vigilante when he and Gloria confront Alice for stealing her recipe. (S7 Ep20)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Walking Big & Tall: Marge urges Homer to lose weight. Instead, he finds a support group that encourages him to embrace his size. Lisa writes an anthem for Springfield. (S26 Ep13/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Princess Guide: Homer chaperones a Nigerian princess while her father negotiates a uranium deal with Mr Burns. He takes her to Moe's bar, where Moe begins to fall for her. (S26 Ep15/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Sky Police: Chief Wiggum uses a military jet pack to fight crime. But when he crashes into the church, Marge and the congregation resort to gambling to pay for the repairs. (S26 Ep16/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Peeping Mom: Bart lies to cover up his role in a bulldozer crash, so Marge decides to follow him everywhere until he confesses. Ned's cute new dog loves Homer. (S26 Ep18/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Ziff Who Came to Dinner: The Simpsons find Marge's high school prom date Artie Ziff squatting in their loft, and he's planning to frame Homer... (S15 Ep14/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Krusty Gets Cancelled: When Krusty's show gets axed, Bart and Lisa enlist Bette Midler, Hugh Hefner, the Red Hot Chili Peppers and Elizabeth Taylor to help him get it back. (S4 Ep22/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: First Dates
E4Plus1.uk.description: Tory Jessie is far from conservative when it comes to talking about sex and politics. How will she get on with journalist Josh? Ex-roadie Winston meets glam gran Donna. (S16 Ep1)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Great Wall
E4Plus1.uk.description: (2017) Fantasy adventure starring Matt Damon and Willem Dafoe. In 11th-century China, Europeans seeking the secret of gunpowder are caught up in a war against alien monsters.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Naked Attraction
E4Plus1.uk.description: Trans woman Amira finally feels happy in her skin and wants a man who's proud to show her off. Rugby player Andy has a soft centre to share with a woman on romantic nights in. (S5 Ep5/5)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Naked Attraction
E4Plus1.uk.description: Emmy-Lou from Brighton appears on the daring dating show for the third time, and forensics student Charlie strips as he seeks his ideal partner in crime. (S6 Ep1)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: On the Box this time, The Outlaws, Family Fortunes, You, Celebrity Yorkshire Auction House, The Mating Game, and ITV News. (S18 Ep8) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: First Dates
E4Plus1.uk.description: Pop singer Ben, who was a smash-hit back in the 1980s, meets Sarah, who used to have his poster above her bed! And will student James's unconventional party trick impress Emilie? (S10 Ep5) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Naked Attraction
E4Plus1.uk.description: Trans woman Amira finally feels happy in her skin and wants a man who's proud to show her off. Rugby player Andy has a soft centre to share with a woman on romantic nights in. (S5 Ep5/5)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: A Wrestler Named Goldberg: Murray coaches Barry for his first high school wrestling match but keeps it a secret from Beverly, who is sure to disapprove. (S1 Ep22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: Livin' on a Prayer: Murray is feted by his old high school for his sporting prowess. Barry throws a party to impress his friends while his parents are away. (S1 Ep23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Don't Tell the Bride: Revisited
E4Plus1.uk.description: Rachel and Adam look back on their unforgettable 1980s Aussie soap wedding. Does Rachel appreciate the effort Adam went to especially for her?

E4Plus1.uk.title: Lego Masters Australia
E4Plus1.uk.description: Land of the Giants: In a colossal challenge, the teams design minifigs interacting with life-size household items, from a kitchen calamity to toilet troubles! (S6 Ep9/12) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Rude(ish) Tube Shorts
E4Plus1.uk.description: A short, cheeky clip from Rude Tube's naughty little sister that features a variety of cats doing strange things, some soldiers stuck in the sand and a dog balancing on a rope.

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Amazing Race Australia
E4Plus1.uk.description: It's the grand finale! The top three teams are pushed to their limits in Kuala Lumpur, before a pit stop finish like never before... Who will win the race? (S7 Ep12)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Married at First Sight USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: With a fractious atmosphere in the air, the couples head off for a weekend retreat. And there are big questions looming for all of the newly-weds. (S19 Ep10)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Married at First Sight USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: As the retreat winds down, one couple make amends while others begin planning for the future. But for one pair, a serious roadblock arises. (S19 Ep11)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Married at First Sight USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: With Decision Day looming, the couples prepare for the biggest call of their lives. Meanwhile, one bride is blindsided by life-changing news. (S19 Ep12)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
E4Plus1.uk.description: (2020) Madcap adventure-comedy video game adaptation with Jim Carrey and Ben Schwartz. Can nippy ring-chasing hedgehog Sonic escape the clutches of an evil, moustachioed scientist?

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Lisa's Belly: Bart and Lisa have to take steroids after getting an infection at a waterpark - and the new drugs have some alarming side effects, particularly for Lisa. (S33 Ep5)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Portrait of a Lackey on Fire: Smithers tires of Mr Burns' indifference and finds solace in the arms of affectionate fashion designer Michael de Graaf. (S33 Ep8/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Mothers and Other Strangers: Homer does therapy to cope with missing his mother, sending him on a trip down memory lane, to when he and Grampa went on a road trip to find her. (S33 Ep9)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: A Made Maggie: Marge sends Homer to find a godfather for an as-yet-unbaptised Maggie. And who'd make a better godfather than mafia don Fat Tony? (S33 Ep10)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Longest Marge: Somehow, Marge and Mr Burns end up co-parenting the Springfield Atoms' new wayward star quarterback. (S33 Ep11)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: So It Has Come to This: A Simpsons Clip Show: Bart's special April Fools' Day prank seriously misfires when the whole house explodes. (S4 Ep18/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Front: At his high school reunion, Homer wins several awards, including 'Most Weight Gained' and 'Most Improved Odour'. But then the Principal finds out he never graduated. (S4 Ep19/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Whacking Day: Lisa asks singer Barry White to help stop the cruel Springfield 'Whacking Day' tradition of hitting snakes with sticks. (S4 Ep20/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Krusty Gets Cancelled: When Krusty's show gets axed, Bart and Lisa enlist Bette Midler, Hugh Hefner, the Red Hot Chili Peppers and Elizabeth Taylor to help him get it back. (S4 Ep22/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Moonfall
E4Plus1.uk.description: (2022) Sci-fi disaster with Halle Berry. A NASA bigwig, a disgraced astronaut and a conspiracy theorist are all that stand between the Earth and a plummeting Moon. But are aliens involved?

E4Plus1.uk.title: Celebrity Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: What do Rylan, Denise van Outen, Laurence and Emilia Fox, Little Mix, Kelly Osbourne and other famous faces think of our top telly, from Killing Eve to Countdown? (S1 Ep1)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Goggleboxers watch Bridgerton, The Apprentice, Secret Genius, Pole to Pole with Will Smith and Motorway Cops: Catching Britain's Speeders. (S27 Ep1)

Film4.uk.title: The Caine Mutiny
Film4.uk.description: (1954) Oscar-nominated Humphrey Bogart, in one of his finest roles, stars in Edward Dmytryk's gripping drama as Captain Philip Queeg, in charge of a US Navy minesweeper during the war.

Film4.uk.title: Santa Fe

Film4.uk.title: Apache Drums
Film4.uk.description: (1951) Stephen McNally stars as a gunslinger who gets slung out of town for gambling too well, but the town might just need him soon in Hugo Fregonese's visually arresting western.

Film4.uk.title: The Land Girls
Film4.uk.description: (1997) Moving Second World War drama starring Catherine McCormack, Rachel Weisz and Anna Friel as young women who volunteer to be agricultural workers and fall for the farmer's son.

Film4.uk.title: Erin Brockovich
Film4.uk.description: (2000) Fact-based legal drama. Julia Roberts won an Oscar, Golden Globe and BAFTA for her portrayal of a single mum making a huge impact at a legal firm despite having no formal training.

Film4.uk.title: Bombshell
Film4.uk.description: (2019) Drama with Charlize Theron, Nicole Kidman and Margot Robbie. Three Fox News employees fight to expose the inappropriate behaviour of a media mogul (John Lithgow).

Film4.uk.title: Hear My Song
